name: woof_doctor
description: Check this machine for WOOF: GPUs and free memory, WOOF install and version, whether runs can launch here or only be planned, and the command that fixes each gap. Call first in a new conversation about simulations.

deep.description: Also run the full engine self-check (uses the GPU; refused while a run is active).

name: woof_catalog
description: List WOOF's live choices: start-data sources, physics suites and mixes, plot products, presets, historical cases, research recipes, global configurations, observation types. Use before choosing any option so every name is real.

query.description: Free-text filter, for example 'tornado 2013' for cases.

id.description: One entry to show in full (case id, recipe id, source id, suite id).

cycle.description: With kind=sources and source: is this cycle (YYYY-MM-DDTHH or latest) available.

check.description: With kind=physics: a mix such as {"microphysics":"thompson-mp8","pbl":"mynn"}; returns whether it runs and the nearest mixes that do.

name: woof_docs
description: Search WOOF's documentation and return the most relevant passages. Use for how-to, option meanings, limits and science background.

name: woof_plan
description: Design one simulation and check it before anything runs: builds the run from a place and settings (or a preset, case or recipe), sizes the grid to the GPU, and returns the grid, memory fit, download, disk, frames and an estimated wall time. Always call before woof_launch. A refusal is a valid answer: explain it and offer the nearest plan that fits.

history_interval_s.description: Root domain output interval in seconds (default 3600).

nest_history_interval_s.description: Every nest's output interval in seconds (default 900).

card.description: Target GPU when not this machine's, for example '24gb' or 'RTX 4090'.

products.description: Plot products or a set name (headline, severe, surface, upper).

name: woof_launch
description: Start a planned run on this machine's GPU. Returns at once with a run id; a message arrives in the chat when the first pictures are ready and when the run ends, so do not poll.

device.description: GPU index or UUID on multi-GPU machines.

name: woof_status
description: State of one run (or all runs when run_id is omitted): stage, progress, speed, time left, frames ready, error and remedy.

name: woof_stop
description: Stop a run this plugin started. Needs confirm=true.

name: woof_show
description: Show a run's weather maps. The images come back to you so you can describe them; copy the MEDIA lines from the result into your reply so the user sees them too.

valid_time.description: latest, all, fNNN or an ISO time.

name: woof_compare
description: Compare two runs product by product: difference maps when the grids match, side-by-side sheets otherwise.

name: woof_campaign
description: Plan and run a set of related simulations that answer one question: a physics, resolution, source, ensemble-member, date, lead-time or case sweep. plan prices every arm and the total against a budget; start queues them; status and stop manage it.

name: woof_score
description: Score a finished run against observations (ASOS surface stations, MRMS radar, Stage-IV rainfall). Runs in the background and posts a message when done.

name: woof_report
description: Summarise a finished run or campaign: setup, estimated vs actual time, health checks, scores and the key maps.
